question: 'Gangaur' is celebrated primarily in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gangaur festival is celebrated in the month of Chaitra in honour of the goddess** Gauri or Parvati**.
 
• This is the festival celebrated in Rajasthan and some parts of Gujarat.
 
• Unmarried women worship Gouri to be blessed with a good husband while married women do this for health and a long and happy life for their husband.
 
• It starts on the first day of Chaitra, the day after Holi and continues for 16 days.
 
• Gangor of Jaipur is world famous.
 
• The sweet dish called ghewar is an important dish of the Gangaur festival.
